answer: The gale graph is validated at intake and the marble frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and nadir anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 315 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. Honest users pay that once, farms 9 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
